_note: Hand fixes for the Sleeping Hound Inn (skyrim-village, 2026-11-15). sky: the analysis's SAM trace took the dark porch beam and the right post for sky and left the real sky out, so the open sky is traced again with SAM from a box and points (the moons, the beam, the lantern, the barrow's arch and the gable's dragon head left out; the small patches it found on the snowy peaks dropped), refined on 4K tiles along its edge and snapped to the silhouette by local color (SAM's whole-frame trace rounded the ridge off by 5-12 px, and the aurora, brightest right at the ridge, left in that band read as a glowing rim), plus the sky seen through the barrow's arch; only_sky keeps the sky to it. aurora: the painted northern lights' box, kept right of the two moons so they never ripple with it, and their green on the river; pull 1, solid and keep 0.0005 (the sky is traced to the silhouette, and the arch's window stays in), silhouette 0.3 (the finial on the arch and bits of its edge, left inside the traced sky, stay on the plate). wheel: the sawmill's waterwheel in 4K px (tools/wheel_layer.py): the front rim's ellipse, two points on each visible spoke (the left one lies under the near end of the axle), the upright spoke every spoke is drawn from, the back rim's offset, what stands in front (the near axle log on the stone pier, the hub boss, the pier), the waterline, one turn in 16 s counterclockwise as seen (the river runs right, the analysis's flow). evergreen_branches_upper (plant, a SAM mask from a box; the static check found it still: "Evergreen branches at the upper left") added by tools/hand_region.py. riverbank_shrubs (plant: the static check found the riverbank's shrubs still on sample v9) traced as their twigs inside hand outlines (a session helper): SAM's trace from the flag's box took the boulder behind them.

regions.name: porch_table
regions.note: the porch table under the sweetroll (SAM, clipped at the post): the depth split found no valley, so slivers of its top read as outdoors and the ants tipped over a false edge there (sample v4)

regions.name: sweetroll
regions.note: the sweetroll itself (SAM): the ants go out of sight behind it (the ant layer's `behind`). The plate is left out of the regions (traced with the roll in it, its id won over the roll's): not_outdoor keeps it dry

regions.name: riverbank_shrubs
regions.note: the frosted shrub in front of the riverbank boulder and the dry grass by the post (the static check on sample v9 found them still), traced as their twigs: thin bright or dark strokes (top-hats of the plate's luminance) inside hand outlines that leave out the snow lump and the boulder's snowy top. SAM's trace from the flag's box took the whole boulder, the snow lump and part of the post, and the sway would have wobbled the rock

_window_disp: the village's lit windows sit nearer than the default band (0.005-0.045) takes for far cabins: the left houses' windows are at 0.05-0.09; 0.1 leaves out the brazier-lit grass (0.29) and a lit patch of ground (0.11). The forge's lit stones come in as reflective, and window events skip those
_not_outdoor: the porch table with its plate and sweetroll, traced (SAM) and closed: under the porch roof, never the view

moon._note: Masser and Secunda lifted as one sprite to cross the sky together, as in the game (plate_fx.moon). Their outlines (polys) are measured by hand: Masser's unlit side shows as a dim red-gray disk beside its lit side, which no brightness threshold takes whole (its lit edge found on a contrast stretch, its dim edge placed by eye; Secunda an ellipse fitted to its limb with its dark crescent). The boxes are where each sits, for the repaint check. The sky they were painted on is repainted (clean.json moons). Neither has a painted glow; the halo stays off (plate_fx.moon halo 0): measured this close to the aurora it would carry aurora light with them
